A yellow paper label with handwritten red text is affixed to the top. The two circular spool windows are visible, showing dark internal mechanisms but lacking clear definition of the tape reels themselves. The central rectangular window for the tape head is present but appears as a dark void. Below the main body, the bottom edge features molded rectangular slots and screw holes. The image has a grainy, noisy texture reminiscent of film or high-ISO digital noise.
